proves.claim: spec approve doctrine:<standard id> then spec apply appends the approved row to DOCTRINE.md and the inherited defaults to review fall by one.

cli.doctrine-decisions.approve-standard-.why: Without it a person could not decide a standard doctrine default through the real spec command.

proves.claim: spec decline doctrine:<standard id> with a reason then spec apply writes its wont line into DOCTRINE.md.

cli.doctrine-decisions.decline-standard-.why: Without it a declined standard default would leave no repo line and keep asking for review.

proves.claim: spec approve doctrine:<standard id> with --text then spec apply writes the exact overridden text into DOCTRINE.md and projects the row approved.

cli.doctrine-decisions.override-standard.why: Without it an overridden standard default could silently keep the packaged text instead of the person's exact wording.
